Question 3
?

Find a vector equation of the normal line to the surface z=2x2+2y2+x at the point (12,1,3).

a
r=⟨−3,−4,1⟩+t⟨12,1,3⟩
b
r=⟨3,−4,1⟩+t⟨12,1,3⟩
c
r=⟨12,1,3⟩+t⟨3,−4,1⟩
d
r=⟨12,1,3⟩+t⟨3,4,1⟩
e
r=⟨12,1,3⟩+t⟨−3,−4,1⟩
Submit
